{{Vanilla|Eye of Ender}}
{{Infobox auto}}
The '''Eye of Ender''' is used to find and activate the {{MCW|End Portal|end portal}}, as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its recipe: instead of a blaze powder and an ender pearl per eye, a [[Stabilized Estus]] and a [[Divine Fragment]] craft 16 eyes at once.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> One craft gives more eyes than a portal needs (12), but it requires a Divine Fragment, so reaching [[The End]] means breaking a [[spawner]] or defeating a strong mob first.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ender_eye.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite video|quote=If you want to get to the end, you need that fragment.}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Eyes of ender are thrown to locate a [[Stronghold|stronghold]] and placed in end portal frames, as in vanilla. They are also used to craft end crystals:
{{Uses}}

== Behavior ==
An eye of ender lying on the ground floats: it has no gravity, sinks slowly while the block three below it is air, and rises while the block half a block below it is not air. It gives off portal particles.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/particle/item_particle_ender_eye_motion.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/0_5/item_particles.mcfunction}}</ref>
